title: Band Illustration in a Hybrid Style of Moebius and Kim Jung Gi
summary: This prompt aims to generate a band image that combines the illustration styles of Moebius and Kim Jung Gi. It features a white minimalist background with layered colored pencil and watercolor techniques, presenting vivi.
